observation.visible_scene: A toy marble-run setup on a green cloth surface: a pink plastic ladder-style track is propped up at one end on a tall wooden block and supported mid-span by a lower wooden block, with the track continuing into a curved section and then a long diagonal straight run. Small artificial pine trees line the wall behind the setup, and separate metal train-track pieces lie on the cloth. A small silver ball sits on the track. A human hand appears at the upper-left near the ball only in the first few frames.
visible_changes: The hand, initially hovering at the top of the ramp beside the ball, retracts toward the left and exits the view by around frame 5.

The silver ball moves continuously along the pink track: descending the initial ramp, traveling the first straight section, rounding the curved right-hand loop, and then proceeding down the diagonal straight section toward the lower-left.

The camera viewpoint shifts and widens steadily over the clip (panning/tilting and pulling back), so the background trees, wooden blocks and metal track pieces change position and more of the overall layout becomes visible; this change is camera motion, not movement of the scenery.
The ball's position relative to the track supports and trees changes frame by frame, confirming it is the moving object while the track and blocks remain fixed in place.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the hand actually released the ball or it was already in motion at the crop start is not established.
The complete track layout and the ball's behavior after the final frame are not shown.
The cause of the ball's descent and any later stopping or leaving the track are outside the excerpt.
uncertain_details: Exact speed changes of the ball are hard to quantify from sampled frames.
Precise framing boundaries of the camera pan/zoom versus the ball's translation are inferred from background shift rather than measured.
The hand's brief proximity to the ball in frames 1-2 does not confirm physical contact.
